# Zapier

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 8 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Automation-platform marketing on a warm cream ground: orange brand buttons, ink plan CTAs, Degular display type, Serrif feature headings, 4px controls and square pricing cards..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Home, pricing, login and signup were measured. Signup was not submitted. SSO was not followed.. Themes: light.

Zapier's public marketing site and signed-out account pages, measured on 19 November 2026. Surfaces: [https://zapier.com/](https://zapier.com/), [https://zapier.com/pricing](https://zapier.com/pricing), [https://zapier.com/app/login](https://zapier.com/app/login) and [https://zapier.com/sign-up](https://zapier.com/sign-up). No account was created and no field was submitted. The only theme on these pages is light. The live tab measured 1169 by 731 CSS pixels at devicePixelRatio 2, not the 1440 and 390 plan widths.

## Typography

10 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Degular Display, Inter, JetBrains Mono, Serrif.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Inter is the UI face, loaded from Google Fonts on the login host and as `Inter` plus `Inter Fallback` on the marketing host. Degular Display is the display face (computed on h1). Serrif is the feature serif (computed on feature headings, weight 300). JetBrains Mono is declared as `--zapier-marketing-font-mono` and was not seen in visible text. Degular Display and Serrif are not committed.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Screenshots are missing. The preview browser returned "The browser is not producing screenshot frames", so layout claims rest on DOM geometry, not images.

The viewport was 1169 wide. Button metrics change at 1024px in the stylesheet (non-xsmall buttons become 48px and 18px). A 1440 or 390 capture was not taken.

Hover, pressed and focus-visible were not held, except the email field, which was already focused and showed the 1px ink ring. Those other states are stylesheet declarations.

Login body text computed to rgb(55, 44, 43), which is not a marketing ramp step. It is stored as `{color.neutral.ink-app}` and should not be treated as the marketing body colour.

Degular Display and Serrif are proprietary. The style guide falls back to Inter and a system serif.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Orange is the one brand action.** "Start free with email", nav Sign up and "Get started for free" use `#ff4f00`. Pricing plan CTAs are ink (`#201515`), and Google or SSO actions are outline buttons. See [components.md](components.md).
- **Display type is Degular, feature type is Serrif, UI type is Inter.** Do not set a Serrif heading in the 600 weight the UI uses. Feature headings computed at weight 300.
- **Nav Sign up is a pill. In-page brand buttons are 4px.** The marketing nav pill measured radius 18px. Login's header Sign up measured radius 40px. Do not round every button into a pill.
- **Pricing cards are square.** Plan cards computed border-radius 0. Feature cards on the home page computed 12px. Do not give plan cards the feature radius.
- **Disabled brand buttons go warm grey, not faded orange.** The empty login Continue button computed fill `#eceae3` and label `#939084`. The stylesheet also sets opacity 0.75.
